method.listing_quote: Generation heading text as printed by the site (e.g. CR '2015-2019' + '2015 Model Redesign Year' badge, cars.com 'Previous generation' + '2015-2019 SONATA'). A range ending in the current/next year (2026/2027) or 'Present' does NOT mean the generation ended; such generations have last_us_model_year null.
method.caveat_cr_badges: CR's 'Model Redesign Year' badge is sometimes applied to freshenings/renames (e.g. Santa Fe 2021, Grand Cherokee 2014, RAV4 2016, Q7 2020, Model 3 2024). Where CR's own text says freshening/refresh/rename, that block is recorded as disputed or as a refresh, not as a new generation.

agreement_values.both_sites: cars.com and CR agree on this boundary year
agreement_values.single_site: only one site gives this boundary
agreement_values.disputed: sites disagree on the year or on whether it is a new generation
